Gen.G is my pick: 88-32 in games this year, and the LCK has taken 10 of the 13 Worlds titles, so I trust them more than anyone else here. BLG is the closest challenger with a huge LPL record and a strong GD@15, but I won't put them above an LCK side with this much region history behind it. With 16 teams left, I'm keeping the probability modest.

Gen.G just feel like the team that has it all figured out: they win with calm and trust in each other, the kind of room where everyone knows their job and nobody's rattled when a game slips. BLG have the form and the swagger, and LCK sides have a long habit of showing up on the Worlds stage, but I'll back the steadiest locker room, 88-32 in games and not a lot of drama.
